notes: v0.17.7: In-game floating text-chat composer for VRChat Mobile using local OSC /chatbox/input on 127.0.0.1:9000, bypassing its broken keyboard. Includes 144-character bound, send-only-on-tap, optional SFX, draft preservation, local-only privacy and pinned shortcut. Enable OSC in VRChat; UDP transmission cannot confirm display. No Shizuku or Node dependency.
